name: bin point clouds into normalized 2d histograms
definition: convert 2d points into a configurable-size 2D histogram over a given bounding box with entries that sum to one.
failure_mode: wrong normalization, wrong shape, or ignoring bounds fails the histogram tests

name: bulk-load a csv file into the database through the client copy command
definition: Import a local CSV into the table using the client-side copy facility so the load is visible on the server.
failure_mode: Loading by another method lacks the required statement evidence.
